title: greener fields
author: Hannah Nash
description: Welcome to greener fields. In this podcast series, host Hannah Nash chats to people about the realities of life in your 20s & 30s, especially regarding what life is like living in Ireland or abroad; the good, the bad, and everything in between to help you decide whether the grass is always greener on the other side, or greener wherever you water it.
